title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 18.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an attacker controlling an upstream repository to alter cached Maven packages from other repositories within the same virtual registry due to improper response validation. This issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
